blocks.text: Condo buildings in West Cambie
Geography note: Covenant Court (9260 No. No. 4 Road — does not reach it. It is named here only so the exclusion is explicit.
Alexandra Court — 9311 and 9399 Alexandra Road; 9366 and 9388 Tomicki Avenue

By Polygon. Current listings date the buildings to 2015 (Alexandra Road addresses) and 2016–2017 (Tomicki Avenue addresses) — a phased complex, so treat the year as address-specific. Building-directory listing headers record a 136-unit wood-frame development at 9366 Tomicki Avenue and a 138-unit wood-frame development at 9399 Alexandra Road (directory, secondary source). Listings describe geothermal heating/cooling (the Alexandra District Energy Utility —), air conditioning, 9-foot ceilings, and a 12,000 sq. ft. clubhouse with outdoor pool, hot tub, gym, basketball court and guest suites. Published restrictions: listings state pets allowed (one listing states 2 pets allowed with no size restriction); a verified building bylaw summary is UNCONFIRMED.
Mayfair Place — 9399 Odlin Road; 9388 McKim Way; also addressed 9288 and 9500 Odlin Road in current listings

By Polygon, designed by Robert Ciccozzi per current listings, in the Alexandra Gardens neighbourhood. Year built conflicts between sources: current listings record 2011 and 2012, while the building directory records 2013 — consistent with a phased build; the conflict is flagged rather than resolved here. One directory page (9388 McKim Way) records restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions. Amenities per directory and listings: air conditioning, club house (the Mayfair Club, 8,000+ sq. ft. per listings), elevator, garden, guest suite, outdoor pool and whirlpool spa. Unit count and construction: listings record frame wood with brick/mixed exterior for one building; a complex-wide figure is UNCONFIRMED.
Omega — 9333 Tomicki Avenue; 9388 Odlin Road

By Concord Pacific; the developer's homeowner page confirms both addresses for Omega. Built 2014 per current listings, which describe geothermal heating and air cooling, a clubhouse and gym. Trap inside the building: a current investor listing offers five of Omega's Low End Market Rental (LEMR) units for sale together as affordable-housing units — LEMR units carry a housing covenant restricting who they can be rented to and at what rent, so an Omega unit must be checked for whether it is a market strata lot or a covenant-restricted LEMR unit before it is priced or marketed as a normal condo. Unit count and market-unit restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked.
Cambridge Park — 9399 Tomicki Avenue; 9500 Odlin Road

By Polygon, per current listings, which describe a courtyard-facing low-rise with 11-foot ceilings in a corner penthouse unit and an efficiently run strata. Year built, unit count, construction and published restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked.
Trafalgar Square — 9500 Tomicki Avenue

By Polygon. Built 2019 per current listings, which record frame-wood construction with mixed exterior, air conditioning, and the 5,000 sq. ft. Trafalgar Club (lounge, billiards, games area, fitness studio, ping pong, landscaped courtyard, children's play area, guest suite). Unit count and published restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked.

items.t: West Cambie is an official City of Richmond planning area in the north-central part of the city, abutting the east side of the City Centre, and includes the Alexandra neighbourhood. The Alexandra neighbourhood is bounded by Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way and No. 4 Road; the DND lands are bounded by No. 4 Road, Alderbridge Way, Shell Road and Westminster Highway. The Area Plan also names two established residential neighbourhoods, The Oaks and Odlinwood. Nearby: Richmond City Centre to the west, East Cambie to the east, Bridgeport to the north, and the Garden City Lands beside the area.

Where the condo stock concentrates: one pocket — the Alexandra / Alexandra Gardens cluster along Alexandra Road, Odlin Road, Tomicki Avenue and McKim Way, where Polygon and Concord Pacific built a run of low-rise strata buildings between 2011 and 2019 (Mayfair Place, Alexandra Court, Omega, Cambridge Park, Trafalgar Square). Outside that pocket, West Cambie is house stock.

Anchors: Tomsett Elementary at 9671 Odlin Road is physically inside the area and A.R. MacNeill Secondary at 6611 No. 4 Road is on its east side; Alexandra Park is at 9600 Odlin Road, linked by sections of the Alexandra Greenway between the Garden City Lands and Cambie Road; Garden City Community Park is at 6620 Garden City Road. Richmond Public Library's Brighouse (Main) Branch is at 100-7700 Minoru Gate in the City Centre and the Cambie Branch at 150-11590 Cambie Road east of the area.

Transit: TransLink route 410 runs on Cambie Road between Richmond-Brighouse Station and 22nd Street Station, connecting the area to the Canada Line at Richmond-Brighouse Station. A City study summary also names routes 407 and 430 fronting Garden City Road, but TransLink timetable verification for those two routes in this area is UNVERIFIED. Main roads: Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way, No. 4 Road and Westminster Highway.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in West Cambie

items.t: District energy — the Alexandra pocket's extra utility: apartment buildings documented by the City in the Alexandra District Energy Utility list include buildings on Alexandra Road, Odlin Road and Tomicki Avenue — the buildings sit on those streets, and their listings describe geothermal heating/cooling. Strata buyers in the Alexandra pocket should expect a district-energy utility connection to form part of carrying costs, charged separately from the strata fee.

Aircraft noise and the Alexandra lot pattern: the Area Plan states the area is affected by aircraft noise from Vancouver International Airport, that no new single-family development is permitted in Alexandra under the OCP Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy, and that an Environmentally Sensitive Area sits in the south-east portion of Alexandra. The older Alexandra pattern also remained on septic sewage disposal — a servicing check for older lots, not for the strata buildings.

Richmond property taxes and utilities: 2026 property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid 2026 taxes after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% penalty on any outstanding balance after Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Annual flat-rate utility payments were due March 31, 2026, with a 10% discount only for payments received on or before the due date.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Cambie

items.t: Five "different" buildings are really one development pocket. Mayfair Place, Alexandra Court, Omega, Cambridge Park and Trafalgar Square all sit within a few blocks on Alexandra Road, Odlin Road, Tomicki Avenue and McKim Way in the Alexandra Gardens pocket — and four of the five are Polygon buildings sharing the same clubhouse template (outdoor pool, guest suite, fitness space) at different scales (Mayfair Club 8,000+ sq. ft., Alexandra Court 12,000 sq. ft., Trafalgar Club 5,000 sq. ft. per listings). Compare them as phases of one idea, not as five unrelated buildings.
The heating system is a municipal utility, not a strata amenity.

Omega hides a rental-housing program inside a market building. Its Low End Market Rental units are covenant-restricted affordable rentals sitting in the same strata as market condos — they surface in investor listings as a five-unit package, and a buyer who assumes every Omega unit is a market unit can price the wrong legal product.

The older Alexandra lots next door run on different rules entirely. The Area Plan records the older Alexandra pattern as 0.4 ha single-family lots remaining on septic disposal, with no new single-family development permitted under the aircraft-noise policy — the condo pocket and the acreage pocket beside it price on completely different logic, and listings that borrow comparables across that line mislead.

A Cambie Road apartment application is in the system, not approved. RZ 23-015980 at 9720 Cambie Road proposes an apartment on a site zoned Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (RSM/XL) in the Alexandra neighbourhood — documented as a rezoning application only. It is not a presale, and no completion or pricing fact about it is verified.

items.t: West Cambie is a City of Richmond planning area in the north central part of the city, abutting the east side of the City Centre, and it includes the Alexandra neighbourhood. The West Cambie Area Plan is Schedule 2.11A to the Official Community Plan (the city-wide plan is Richmond's 2041 OCP, Bylaw 9000); the Area Plan was adopted July 24, 2006. Within the area, the Alexandra neighbourhood is bounded by Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way and No. 4 Road, and the DND lands are bounded by No. 4 Road, Alderbridge Way, Shell Road and Westminster Highway.
Nearby areas: Richmond City Centre to the west, East Cambie to the east, Bridgeport to the north, and the Garden City Lands beside the area.
All market figures for this area: UNVERIFIED.

Transit and roads: route 410 runs on Cambie Road between Richmond-Brighouse Station and 22nd Street Station via Cambie Road, No. 6 Road, Highway 91, Westminster Highway and the Queensborough Bridge, connecting the area to the Canada Line at Richmond-Brighouse Station. Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way, No. 4 Road and Westminster Highway are the main roads.

Schools: SD38 catchments are address-based; SD38 has no middle-school tier — elementary is Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary is Grades 8 to 12. The locator result for the sample address 9671 Odlin Road is Tomsett Elementary (K–7) and MacNeill Secondary (8–12); Tomsett Elementary at 9671 Odlin Road is physically inside West Cambie, and A.R. MacNeill Secondary at 6611 No. 4 Road is on the area's east side.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in West Cambie

items.t: Form B diligence (all 3 strata complexes above): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. In Alexandra, the Form B package is also where the district-energy charges (below) surface — read the utility lines, not just the strata fee.

Suites / SSMUH: the City states Richmond allows at least one secondary suite and/or an accessory dwelling unit per lot on covered lots, with provincial small-scale multi-unit housing minimums of three units on lots 280 m² or less and four units on lots greater than 280 m².

Alexandra District Energy Utility (ADEU) — a West Cambie carrying cost: apartment and townhouse buildings in the Alexandra pocket connect to the City-owned district energy utility, and its charges form part of a strata home's carrying costs on top of the strata fee. The City's ADEU building list covers buildings on Alexandra Road, Odlin Road and Tomicki Avenue — pull the utility charges from the strata documents for any Alexandra Road purchase rather than assuming standard utilities.

Servicing and noise — older Alexandra: the Area Plan records the older Alexandra lot pattern remaining on septic sewage disposal — confirm sewer connection status and cost before subject removal on any older Alexandra property — and states the area is affected by aircraft noise from Vancouver International Airport, with no new single-family development permitted in Alexandra under the OCP Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy.

City taxes and utilities: City of Richmond 2026 property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid 2026 taxes after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% penalty on any outstanding balance after Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Annual flat-rate utility payments were due March 31, 2026, with a 10% discount only for payments received on or before the due date; the City's discounted cost for a typical single-family metered residence for 2026 totals $2,251 per year (water $631, sewer $835, garbage/recycling/environmental programs $443, flood protection $342) — strata townhouse utility treatment runs through the strata and the ADEU instead: read the Form B.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Cambie

items.t: Alexandra's big lots come with a septic past.

Aircraft noise is a development rule here, not just a nuisance. The Area Plan states West Cambie is affected by Vancouver International Airport noise and that no new single-family development is permitted in Alexandra under the OCP Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy — which is part of why the Alexandra rebuild product is townhouse and apartment form under site-specific zones like ZT71.

The greenway runs through the townhouse pocket. Alexandra Park is at 9600 Odlin Road, linked by sections of the Alexandra Greenway between the Garden City Lands and Cambie Road — the park-and-greenway spine sits between the Alexandra Road complexes, a fact listing copy for Jayden Mews, Suncrest and Museo rarely maps.

The dikes are being raised around this area right now. Richmond's flood system is designed for a 1:500 event, with dike raising from the current 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres under way to stay ahead of sea level rise — the FCL conversation in West Cambie sits on top of a live capital program, not a static bylaw.
The area's library and hospital are outside it.

A DND lands block sits inside the planning area. The Area Plan bounds a DND lands parcel by No. 4 Road, Alderbridge Way, Shell Road and Westminster Highway — federal land inside the West Cambie boundary that does not turn over like the surrounding residential lots.

blocks.text: Lots and land in West Cambie
Fee-simple lots

items.t: The Oaks and Odlinwood house lots: freehold detached houses in The Oaks (described in the Area Plan as a low-scale residential neighbourhood) and Odlinwood (an established residential neighbourhood), and on the older Alexandra lots.

The older Alexandra pattern — the area's defining lot character: single-family homes on 0.4 ha lots in the older pattern, under Single Detached (RS1/F) in the older Alexandra pattern shown in the Area Plan and City applications, all under Richmond Zoning Bylaw 8500. Current parcel sizes vary by zone; the specific zone and minimums for a lot are confirmed with the City.

Serviced position — split, as the Area Plan states it: the Alexandra part of West Cambie was described in the Area Plan as remaining on septic sewage disposal in its older lot pattern — a material servicing check for older Alexandra lots; wells are recorded in the provincial GWELLS registry where they exist. No equivalent septic position is documented for The Oaks / Odlinwood streets in the research — servicing for any single parcel is confirmed with the City, UNCONFIRMED parcel-by-parcel here.

ALR vs non-ALR: West Cambie is not described as Agricultural Land Reserve land in the Area Plan, and no ALR parcel or ALR percentage split for the area is stated in the research. ALR status remains a per-address check on ALC maps for any parcel where it matters.

Flood position — applies to every lot: Richmond is islands in the Fraser River floodplain at an average of 1 metre above sea level, protected by 49 km of dikes designed for a 1:500 event, with dike raising from 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres under way; all lands are designated flood plain under Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw No. 8204, with flood construction levels (FCLs) habitable floors must meet unless exempt.

Noise / environment position on the Alexandra ground: the Area Plan states the area is affected by aircraft noise from Vancouver International Airport, that no new single-family development is permitted in Alexandra due to the Official Community Plan Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy, and that an Environmentally Sensitive Area is in the south-east portion of Alexandra. That policy line is the single biggest constraint on what an older Alexandra lot can become.
Market context: none quoted. Land has no SnapStats category in any case.

items.t: The Alexandra Road assembly pattern (completed): the Alexandra pocket's apartment and townhouse buildings stand on assembled Alexandra Road / Odlin Road / Tomicki Avenue ground rezoned under site-specific zones — Town Housing zones such as ZT67 and ZT71 on Alexandra Road in the Area Plan / City applications record.

: Polygon Jayden Mews Homes Ltd. rezoned the assembled site at 9700 and 9740 Alexandra Road under application RZ 13-649641 to the site-specific Town Housing zone ZT71 for approximately 64 three-storey townhomes (City Planning Committee report, May 20, 2014).

9720 Cambie Road (City application RZ 23-015980): an apartment proposed on a site zoned Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (RSM/XL) in the West Cambie Area Plan – Alexandra Neighbourhood. Documented in the research as a rezoning application only — not an approved project, not a presale, and not a lot offering.
Camden Square — 9300 Cambie Road. An apartment presale, not lots: Cross-referenced here as a development site on Cambie Road only; it sells strata homes, not lots, and no lot count is taken from it.

The DND lands — a named Area Plan land unit, not inventory: the Area Plan bounds the DND lands by No. 4 Road, Alderbridge Way, Shell Road and Westminster Highway. No development, offering or disposition position for those lands is documented in the research — UNCONFIRMED beyond the boundary statement, and never presented as for-sale land.

blocks.text: District energy ground

items.t: Alexandra District Energy Utility (ADEU): apartment buildings documented by the City in the ADEU list include buildings on Alexandra Road, Odlin Road and Tomicki Avenue (Alexandra Court, Mayfair Place, Omega and Trafalgar among them) — a district-energy utility connection forms part of carrying costs for strata on that ground, charged separately from the strata fee. For land purposes: Alexandra assembly ground carries a district-energy servicing relationship that The Oaks / Odlinwood fee-simple streets do not document — price it into any Alexandra redevelopment or strata purchase from the strata / utility documents, not from a standard utility assumption.

blocks.text: Checked and excluded

items.t: Covenant Court — 9260 No. 2 Road: A listing record confirms the address, the Woodwards sub-area, a 1994 build, apartment type, and a 55+ age rule. items.t: West Cambie is in the north central part of Richmond, in the City of Richmond, BC, in Metro Vancouver, abutting the east side of the City Centre, and includes the Alexandra neighbourhood. West Cambie is an official City planning area name — the West Cambie Area Plan, Schedule 2.11A to the Official Community Plan.

Boundaries as the Area Plan states them: the Alexandra neighbourhood is bounded by Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way and No. 4 Road, and the DND lands are bounded by No. 4 Road, Alderbridge Way, Shell Road and Westminster Highway. The two established residential neighbourhoods named in the Area Plan are The Oaks and Odlinwood.

Main roads: Cambie Road, Garden City Road, Alderbridge Way, No. 4 Road and Westminster Highway; Highway 91 is reached to the east and Highway 99 to the west and south from the City Centre side, and the Area Plan notes walking distance to the City Centre. Transit: route 410 runs on Cambie Road between Richmond-Brighouse Station and 22nd Street Station, connecting the area to the Canada Line; routes 407 and 430 on Garden City Road are named in a City study summary only — TransLink timetable verification for those two is UNVERIFIED. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Civic anchors: Alexandra Park, 9600 Odlin Road, linked by sections of the Alexandra Greenway between the Garden City Lands and Cambie Road; Garden City Community Park, 6620 Garden City Road, beside the area; Cambie Community Centre, 12800 Cambie Road, east of the area (a community centre inside West Cambie itself: UNVERIFIED); Richmond Public Library Brighouse (Main) Branch, 100-7700 Minoru Gate, and Cambie Branch, 150-11590 Cambie Road; Richmond Hospital, 7000 Westminster Highway. Shopping centre or grocery store in or beside West Cambie confirmed on an official source: UNVERIFIED.

Schools: SD38 catchments are address-based and SD38 has no middle-school tier — elementary K–7, secondary 8–12. Tomsett Elementary, 9671 Odlin Road, is physically inside West Cambie and A.R. MacNeill Secondary, 6611 No. 4 Road, is on the east side of the area. That sample result does not transfer to other addresses — every other catchment is UNVERIFIED and must be run in the locator.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in West Cambie

items.t: Aircraft-noise constraint (Alexandra): no new single-family development is permitted in Alexandra under the OCP Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy, per the Area Plan — a lot-level development constraint, not a marketing footnote.

ADEU carrying cost (Alexandra ground only): buildings on the City's ADEU list (Alexandra Road, Odlin Road, Tomicki Avenue) carry a district-energy utility charge on top of strata fees and standard utilities — pull the actual charge from the strata documents for any Alexandra purchase.

Covenant vs bylaw — the Omega LEMR point: strata rental-restriction bylaws are VOID since November 24, 2022, but Omega's Low End Market Rental units are restricted by a registered housing covenant, not a bylaw — covenants were not voided and those units remain rental-restricted today. Check whether a specific Omega unit is a market strata lot or an LEMR covenant unit from title before pricing it.

ALR rules (for completeness — no West Cambie ALR parcel is documented here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Richmond property taxes and utilities: 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 1, 2026. Flat-rate utilities were due March 31, 2026 with the 10% early-payment discount lost if paid late; the typical single-family metered total for 2026 is $2,251 per year (water $631, sewer $835, garbage/recycling/environmental programs $443, flood protection $342) — Alexandra strata additionally carry the ADEU charge above, which appears in neither figure.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Cambie

items.t: The heating system on Alexandra ground is a municipal utility, not an amenity (City list, read 2026-11-01): the Alexandra buildings' geothermal heating/cooling runs through the Alexandra District Energy Utility (delivered by the Lulu Island Energy Company, per the City council document the research cites) — an ongoing utility relationship with its own charges that survives resale and never appears in a listing's strata-fee line.

An Environmentally Sensitive Area sits inside Alexandra: the Area Plan places an ESA in the south-east portion of Alexandra, alongside the aircraft-noise constraint — two separate overlays on the same large-lot ground, both checkable only parcel by parcel.

"Lower Landing" is not a Richmond name: the official name is London Landing (Steveston). It is outside this area in any case and is recorded here only so the wrong name is never used in West Cambie copy.

Page-statement check for this area. Approved page claims, where a live page states them, are the settled set only: REALTOR since 2015; 10 straight years in the FVREB Medallion Club; Top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors; #1 in South Surrey/White Rock by MLS points for 2025 and 2026 YTD; more than $500M in sales.

faq.q: Which public schools are in West Cambie?
faq.a: Tomsett Elementary at 9671 Odlin Road is physically inside West Cambie; for the sample address used (9671 Odlin Road), the SD38 locator gives Tomsett Elementary and MacNeill Secondary — catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator, and SD38 has no middle school tier.

faq.q: What do the suite and small-scale multi-unit rules allow in West Cambie?
faq.a: The City states Richmond allows at least one secondary suite and/or an accessory dwelling unit per lot on covered lots, with provincial minimums of three units on lots 280 m² or less and four units on larger lots, and a Cambie Road application shows Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (RSM/XL) zoning in the Alexandra neighbourhood.

faq.q: What flood and noise matters are documented for West Cambie?
faq.a: City flood material describes a perimeter dike system designed for a 1:500 event with dike raising from 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres city-wide, all lands are designated flood plain under Bylaw No. 8204, and the Area Plan states West Cambie is affected by aircraft noise from Vancouver International Airport with no new single-family development permitted in Alexandra under the Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy.

faq.q: What plan covers West Cambie, and is a new project listed?
faq.a: The West Cambie Area Plan is Schedule 2.11A to the Official Community Plan, under the city-wide 2041 OCP, Bylaw 9000; a rezoning application at 9720 Cambie Road for an apartment is documented as an application, not as an approved project or presale.

faq.q: What extra cost comes with the Alexandra buildings' geothermal heating?
faq.a: The Alexandra District Energy Utility. The City's utility building list covers the Alexandra Road / Odlin Road / Tomicki Avenue buildings, and listings for Alexandra Court and Omega describe geothermal heating/cooling — the utility charge is separate from the strata fee, so pull it from the strata documents and price it into carrying costs rather than assuming standard utilities.

faq.q: Is an Omega unit a normal market condo?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Omega (9333 Tomicki Avenue / 9388 Odlin Road, Concord Pacific, built 2014) contains Low End Market Rental units held under a housing covenant — a current listing offers five LEMR units together as affordable-housing product. A market unit and an LEMR unit in the same building are different legal products; confirm which one is being sold, from the title and covenant, before pricing.

faq.q: Are pets allowed in the Alexandra pocket buildings?
faq.a: Published positions: Mayfair Place — pets allowed with restrictions (building directory, for 9388 McKim Way). Alexandra Court — listings state pets allowed, one stating 2 pets with no size restriction; a verified bylaw summary is UNCONFIRMED. Cambridge Park, Trafalgar Square and Omega market units: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked. Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC, so the registered bylaws on the Form B govern.

faq.q: Can I rent out a West Cambie condo long-term?
faq.a: For a market strata lot, yes — rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022. The exception that matters here is not a bylaw at all: an Omega LEMR unit's rental is governed by its housing covenant (eligible tenants and capped rents), which the 2022 change does not void. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw.

faq.q: How old is the condo stock, and who built it?
faq.a: It is one building wave: Mayfair Place (listings 2011–2012, directory 2013), Omega (2014), Alexandra Court (2015–2017 by address), Trafalgar Square (2019) — Polygon built four of the five named complexes and Concord Pacific built Omega. All are low-rise; the directory records wood-frame construction for the Alexandra Court phases. Depreciation reports are now mandatory on a five-year cycle for all of them.

All of the verified stock is on one street: Jayden Mews (9700 / 9740 Alexandra Road, approximately 64 homes, built 2015), Suncrest (9560 Alexandra Road, 2018) and Museo (9680 Alexandra Road) in the Alexandra pocket. The Oaks and Odlinwood are detached-house neighbourhoods; there is no townhouse stock there.

faq.q: What extra monthly cost comes with an Alexandra Road townhouse?
faq.a: District energy: buildings in the pocket connect to the Alexandra District Energy Utility, and its charges sit on top of the strata fee as part of carrying costs. The City's ADEU building list covers the Alexandra Road buildings — pull the actual charges from the Form B package instead of budgeting from the strata fee alone.

faq.q: Is Museo 96 units, and was it built in 2016 or 2017?
faq.a: Both figures are UNCONFIRMED: the 96-unit figure appears only in secondary directories and was not confirmed on a citable source, and listings at 9680 Alexandra Road record both 2016 and 2017 as the build year. The strata plan and Form B settle both — do not quote either number as fact.
